name: Quiver
description: Arrows in a quiver: a narrow fan leaning off the vertical.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 218deg at 50% 100%, #000 0 7deg, transparent 7deg 15deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 218deg at 50% 100%, #000 0 7deg, transparent 7deg 15deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-14deg, 0deg, 14deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-14deg, 0deg, 14deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
